info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Status API provides users with the current statuses of real estate listings. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve comprehensive information about listings, including their availability and any relevant changes. Typical use cases include property management systems, real estate platforms, and applications needing status updates for listings. By accessing this API, developers can ensure their applications display the most up-to-date information for users interested in real estate opportunities.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of listings.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of all listings. It's useful for understanding whether listings are active, inactive, or require attention.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the status of listings that the user wants to retrieve. The format must be JSON and should adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of listings.

ListRealestateListingsStatusRequest.title: Get Listings Status Request Body Schema
